description: Convert between a nominal annual rate (APR) and the effective annual yield (APY) for a given compounding frequency. With direction "apr-to-apy" the input is the nominal APR and the effective APY is computed as (1 + apr/n)^n - 1; with "apy-to-apr" the input is the effective APY and the APR is recovered as n * ((1 + apy)^(1/n) - 1). Both rates are percentages.

compoundsPerYear.description: Compounding periods per year (12 = monthly, 365 = daily)

direction.description: Which rate the input represents and which to compute

rate.description: The known rate as a percent: the nominal APR when direction is "apr-to-apy", or the effective APY when direction is "apy-to-apr"

name: convert_apr_apy
